title: Small-bias generator bounds
statement: Let $n,\ell$ be positive integers and let $\varepsilon>0$ satisfy $n\leq \varepsilon 2^\ell$ and $2^\ell\leq 4n/\varepsilon$. Identify the field $\mathbb{F}_{2^\ell}$ with $\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$ by a basis, and for $r,s\in\mathbb{F}_{2^\ell}$ form the vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ whose $i$th coordinate is the dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the coordinate vectors of $r^{i+1}$ and $s$, for $0\leq i<n$. The probability distribution obtained by choosing $(r,s)$ uniformly has density relative to the uniform distribution on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ whose every nonzero Walsh coefficient has absolute value at most $\varepsilon$; moreover, the multiset of generated vectors, counted with multiplicity, has size at most $16(n/\varepsilon)^2$.
